The structure of Mg12Cu8O20 (reduced formula Mg3Cu2O5) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Cu and Mg centers, each with six oxygen neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between CuO6 and MgO6 octahedra, and edge-sharing between like octahedra.
